text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged canary for service `inference-v2` -> gradual 5% -> 20% in eu-west. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Stop/go call now. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency > 350ms. Rollback image: redwood/inference:v1.9. Details: https://deploys.redwood/internal/roll/1716009876

maria g: seeing p99 tail creep on canary pods, spikes up to ~420ms on 3 pods. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123

jonathan: also seeing ~0.8% 5xx (mostly 502) on canary slice, not yet in prod traffic outside eu-west

sreekar: kvcache miss-rate jumped after new shard layout, suspect cold-cache + smaller cache quota per pod. trying a repro locally

jess: can we pin routing to v1.9 quickly if this worsens? prefer pin > blind rollback if behavior diverges

jonathan: we can pin canary routing via feature flag (ff.routing.inference=stable:v1.9) but it changes response distributions slightly

maria g: vote: pause traffic increase and investigate. if no fix in 10m -> rollback

sreekar: I can try resizing cache env var and rolling canary pods, ETA ~6m for change + rollout

ops-bot: Autoscaler update: desired=12 current=12 stable, no restarts or OOMs reported in cluster events

jess: ok please @deploy-bot pause the percentage increase. document rollback steps in thread

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout at 5% now. To rollback run: `deploy rollback inference-v2 --to v1.9 --scope canary` or use Console > Rollbacks. Holding further shifts.

jonathan: +1 rollback if no improvement in 8m

maria g: noted. tagging @sreekar for hotfix attempt

sreekar: pushed cache config hotfix to canary: `CACHE_SIZE=768Mi`. applying with: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-cache CACHE_SIZE=768Mi -n eu-west`

ops-bot: Hotfix applied: 3/3 canary pods updated, rollout status: OK

maria g: after patch p99 back to ~300ms and 5xx down to 0.2%. recommending resume and ramp to 20% while we monitor

jess: vote: resume. monitor 10m closely

maria g: resuming traffic to 20% now

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 20%. Monitoring window started. Reminder rollback thresholds still: error_rate > 1.5% OR p99 > 350ms. :eyes:

jonathan: watching logs/metrics, will flag immediately if regression

maria g: will close thread after 30m if stable, thanks everyone
